spans.quote: as long as one has banished torpor,
one should be determined on this mindfulness.

instructions.object: any posture, as long as one is not drowsy

spans.quote: may all beings be happy at heart.

attention.note: “happy at heart” / “cultivate the heart”: the heart shown as a warm point in the middle of the chest

spans.quote: As a mother would risk her life
to protect her child, her only child,
even so should one cultivate the heart limitlessly
One should protect one’s goodwill toward all beings in the same way that a mother would protect her only child.

attention.note: “happy at heart” / “cultivate the heart”: the heart shown as a warm point in the middle of the chest

instructions.note: read with the translator’s note 1: the parallel is the meditator’s goodwill, protected as a mother protects her only child

spans.quote: With goodwill for the entire cosmos,

attention.note: the entire cosmos, above, below and all around → the light widened around the body (space)

coverage_rules.reason: the conduct of one who practises goodwill (capable, upright, easy to instruct…, doing nothing the wise would censure): a way of life, kept for Ask/Theory, not a timed step
